scope: Every production queryFn property and every exported non-generated API function declaration, including synchronous wrappers, helpers, streams and mutations.

dynamicBoundaries: k8sGet/list and Kubernetes-resource helpers use the canonical bounded proxy adapters and explicit read signals; API writes keep their own lifetime.
streamPodLogs and subscribeCharlieSessionEvents are subscriptions whose callers own close/cancellation; neither is a queryFn.
Generated executeOpenAPI takes a runtime operation ID, with canonical operationMetadata supplying the method/path; per-operation generated exports are governed by openapi:check.
manualReview.qualification: Ownership classification follows statically resolved generated operations and explicit shared/session/stream boundaries. It is not a whole-callgraph or every-branch cancellation proof; real HTTP tests and browser behavior provide representative runtime evidence.
